in total: The trip to Beijing cost three thousand yuan in total.
去北京的旅行总共花了三千元。

我的曾祖父在第二次世界大战期间是一名士兵。
drop by: Please drop by my house when you are free this weekend.
这周末有空时请顺便来我家坐坐。
get mad: Don't get mad at me; I didn't break your glasses.
别冲我发火，我没有弄坏你的眼镜。
make an effort: If you make an effort every day, your English will improve quickly.
如果你每天都努力，你的英语会很快提高。
go out of one’s way: She went out of her way to help the old man cross the street.
她特地帮那位老人过马路。

好客的女主人做了一大桌饭菜，让我们感到宾至如归。
Colombia VmbI: My uncle plans to visit Colombia next winter to see the rainforests.
我叔叔计划明年冬天去哥伦比亚看雨林。

the more … the more: The more you read, the more words you will learn.
你读得越多，学到的单词就越多。
leave out: Don't leave out any details when you tell the story.
你讲故事时不要遗漏任何细节。
prime minister: The prime minister gave a speech on television last night.
首相昨晚在电视上发表了讲话。

我的父母和祖父母都没出过国。

他选择待在家里，而不是冒雨外出。

如果我们齐心协力，就能在中午前把公园打扫完。
give ... a lift: Could you give me a lift to the airport tomorrow morning?
明天早上你能捎我去机场吗？
take off: The plane will take off in twenty minutes, so please hurry.
飞机二十分钟后起飞，请抓紧时间。
New Zealand: My dream is to visit New Zealand and see its beautiful mountains.
我的梦想是去新西兰看那里美丽的山脉。
upside down: The little boy held the map upside down and got completely lost.
小男孩把地图拿倒了，完全迷了路。
in a row: Our team has won five games in a row this season.
我们队这个赛季已经连赢五场比赛了。
make a mess: The children made a mess in the kitchen while baking cookies.
孩子们烤饼干时把厨房弄得一团糟。
keep one’s cool: Try to keep your cool even when the questions become really difficult.
即使问题变得很难，也要保持冷静。
senior high (school): My brother will study hard to enter a good senior high school.
我哥哥会努力学习，考上一所好的高中。
believe in: If you believe in yourself, you can overcome most difficulties in life.
如果你相信自己，就能克服生活中的大部分困难。
be responsible for: Everyone in the class should be responsible for keeping the library quiet.
班里的每个人都应该负责保持图书馆安静。

首先，让我感谢大家来参加这次会议。
lost and found box: Someone found your keys in the lost and found box this morning.
今天早上有人在失物招领箱里发现了你的钥匙。

泡茶的时候你要小心热水。
from now on: From now on, I will spend half an hour reading English every day.
从现在开始，我每天要花半小时读英语。

这就是你要的我们班的照片，在这儿呢。

电影开始前请关掉你的手机。
lost and found office: I went to the lost and found office to look for my umbrella.
我去失物招领处找我的雨伞。
in a hurry: He left home in a hurry and forgot to take his homework.
他匆忙离开家，忘了带作业。
that's all: That's all I want to say about the plan for now.
关于这个计划，我想说的就这些。
worry about: Don't worry about the exam; you have prepared well for it.
别担心考试，你已经准备得很充分了。
Mary gets on well with her new classmates and feels happy here.
玛丽和新同学们相处融洽，在这里感到很开心。
We should be ready to help others whenever they are in trouble.
无论何时别人有困难，我们都应该乐于帮忙。

小女孩唱歌就像她妈妈一样，轻柔又甜美。
go over: Let's go over the new words again before tomorrow's test.
明天考试之前，我们再把生词复习一遍。
